title: Message people on Nostr from People
changes: Message anyone on Nostr from People. A conversation opens as a chat beside your list, with no separate message window.
Someone you have not talked to arrives as a message request. Their name and picture stay hidden unless you reply.
Invite someone to a private chat from their conversation. A short note tells them first.
Block someone from their conversation. The block stays on this device, and they are not told.
Send from People while a room or call is open. Settings › Account holds your Nostr inbox switch and inbox relays.
Personas with the same name show both ends of their keys.
